title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
content: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

title: Trump's Democratic SEC pick suggests tokenization policy deserves full rule process
content: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee held a confirmation hearing for the two nominees — one from each party — as the administration rebuilds the markets regulators.

title: Anthropic gains after IPO, but pulls off highest levels
content: After opening at $111.50, ANT quickly slipped back under $100, still above its $83 offering price.

title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
content: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
content: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.

title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
content: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.

title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
content: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
content: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.

title: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Sink as Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price
content: Anthropic shares opened 34% above their $83 IPO price before giving up much of the gain, while Nvidia, AMD and other AI stocks slid across Wall Street.

title: Meet SHRINCS: Bitcoin's Emerging Frontrunner for a Post-Quantum Signature
content: A new post-quantum signature proposal aims to secure Bitcoin’s future, but balancing user safety and efficiency comes with hurdles.

title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
content: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.

title: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street
content: Anthropic shares surged on their Nasdaq debut, but stocks slid and Bitcoin fell lower. Its daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum, a strong downtrend, and fragile support.

title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
content: At least four people were arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic’s historic IPO, as protesters warned that AI valuations could leave retirement savers exposed to a potential market crash and broader economic losses.

title: Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month
content: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month The bitcoin price slumped under $62,000 on Thursday, down about 24% in one month, as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut set off a tech selloff that hit crypto stocks. This post Bitcoin Price Slumps Under $62,000, Crashing 25% in One Month first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Darius Dale: 2027 Should Be a “Great Year for Bitcoin” as Fed Rate Cuts Come Darius Dale, Founder & CEO of 42 Macro, joins BMTV to answer whether the Fed is making a policy mistake with a December rate hike priced in. title: Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record
content: Bitcoin Magazine Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record Galaxy Research says 13F filers added 49,229 BTC through U.S. spot bitcoin ETPs in Q3, lifting institutional holdings to a record 356,491 BTC as Wells Fargo became the largest holder. This post Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K Katie Stockton, Founder of Fairlead Strategies, joins BMTV as Bitcoin falls below its 200-week moving average, sitting at about $63,000 per the host. This post Bitcoin’s Last Line of Defense Is $58K first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .

title: Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000
content: Bitcoin Magazine Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 The Swiss bank estimates bitcoin could hit a new all-time high near $128,000 and calls the current downturn the shallowest bear market to date, as bitcoin moves into reserve portfolios. This post Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
